name: binaryDecode
description:
Converts a string to a binary object. Used to convert
binary data that has been encoded into string format
back into binary data.
syntax: binaryDecode( string encoded_binary, string binaryEncoding, [boolean precise] )

params.name: encoded_binary
params.description: A string containing encoded binary data.

params.name: binaryEncoding
params.description:
A string specifying the algorithm used to encode the original
binary data into a string; must be one of the following:

- hex: characters 0-9 and A-F represent the hexadecimal value of each byte
- UU: data is encoded using the UNIX UUencode algorithm
- base64: data is encoded using the Base64 algorithm
- base64url: data is encoded using the URL and filename safe Base64 alphabet (- and _ instead of + and /), as specified by IETF RFC 4648 section 5, as used for example by JWT, OAuth and PKCE. The padding (=) is optional when decoding.

params.name: precise
params.description: if set to true the input must follow the rule for that encoding a 100%, the decryptor will not try to interpret inputs that are not a 100% correct. This should be used to avoid false positives.
